items.summaryEn: Formula 1 will race in Madrid for the first time in 45 years this weekend at the Madring circuit, which has secured a 10-year tenure of the Spanish Grand Prix. The 57-lap circuit is described as a two-headed monster that will take drivers and teams some time to understand from an engineering perspective.
detailZh: 随着马德里赛道赛道首秀，F1最新一站比赛值得期待什么
时隔45年，一级方程式本周末将首次在马德里比赛，赛道是具有双重特性的马德里赛道
马德里将承办西班牙大奖赛为期十年，从如今改为两年一届的巴塞罗那比赛中接过了这一名号，这是F1将赛事带到城市人口中心的最新举措。
比赛将在一条拥有“双头怪兽”之称的赛道上进行57圈，车手和车队需要一些时间才能让他们的工程思维完全理解这条赛道。
所谓的马德里赛道赛道最初的效果图引发了褒贬不一的反应，人们担心西班牙大奖赛从巴塞罗那的永久性赛道迁至马德里主机场附近的Valdebebas地区后，F1会再添一条千篇一律的街道赛，一个很快就会被弃用的钢筋水泥丛林。甚至无需走出西班牙国界，就能让人想起早已停办的瓦伦西亚大奖赛——那场在如今已成幽灵赛道上举办的、如海鲜饭锅般昙花一现的乏味比赛。
我们六月对现场的首次考察表明，这条最初由Dromo设计、后期施工阶段移交给Tilke完成的赛道，其最终成品Certainly远没有那些传言那么糟糕。但它也确实与赛历上其他任何一条赛道都不相同。
起终点直道周围区域位于IFEMA会展中心的广场和公共道路上，这无疑让第一个赛段有一种走走停停的感觉，令人联想到迈阿密和新加坡之类的赛道。
最醒目的地标，也是比赛官方海报和其他宣传材料上的主角，是La Monumental；这是一条长而快的倾斜弯道，坡度达到了允许的最大值24%。这条550米长的弯道比赞德沃特那条大致可类比的最后弯要长得多，因为它环绕赛道北端专门修建的区域划出了一个270度的弧线。
纪念碑赛道的陡峭弯道倾角具有不断变化的坡度和高度
这座高耸的弯道外侧设有大看台，其坡度、半径和高度的持续变化使其与赛历上的其他倾斜弯道或椭圆形赛道上的弯道截然不同，亲临现场时给人留下了震撼的印象。这里没有缓冲区，但外侧装有SAFER护栏。
“这是一个非常非常特别的弯道，” 勒克莱尔 在与法拉利进行尘土飞扬的拍摄日并勘察该弯道后说道。“在这个弯道，我感觉在排位赛中我们必须非常勇敢，因为它将达到极限。
“我确实相信它有潜力成为本赛季最具标志性的弯道之一，尤其是配上那个大看台。这将为这个弯道的体验增色。有一点是肯定的，那就是你必须全身心地投入。”
那个弯角之后是一连串的高速变向，而且缓冲区很小。正如一次红旗频出的F3测试所表明的那样，这条赛道在第一年将很难应付。
初步迹象表明，马德里赛道 即使不会成为车手们最喜欢的赛道，也将是在排位赛中颇具挑战性的赛道。不过，这条赛道能否呈现精彩的比赛场面，目前还没有定论。由于拥有众多制动区，这条赛道在能量回收的难度方面应该处于中游水平。超车看起来并不容易，3号弯和5号弯之间的直道是最明显的超车机会。
"这将是一条非常有挑战性的赛道，"Leclerc 委婉地说。"我不知道超车情况如何，我不确定会有很多超车，我希望我错了。但我认为排位赛以及驾驶这样一条赛道的挑战，将会是本赛季最酷的体验之一。"
马德里能为F1提供什么，而巴塞罗那仍在为此苦苦挣扎
马德里真正想做出差异化的是它的交通可达性。这条赛道不仅距离机场很近，还与马德里庞大的地铁和市郊铁路网络相连。主办方承诺从首都任何地方都能便捷无阻地抵达赛道，而这长期以来正是巴塞罗那的一大痛点。
在这方面，它正是F1管理层如今所青睐的那类场馆。一场与“目的地城市”深度融合的城市比赛，拥有各种配套设施、内置的交通与可持续解决方案，以及容纳大规模VIP设施的空间。
“嗯，你比我更清楚，进出一条传统赛道有多麻烦。这里南边有地铁，北边有市郊铁路，将会非常方便，”IFEMA的首席运营官Carlos Jimenez承诺道，“这两条线路都很快、停靠站很少，因为它们的设计初衷就是快速连接机场和市中心。所以，我们认为车迷抵达赛道的体验将是一个决定性的优势。
“这非常便利，但代价是我们必须更加努力，才能提供良好的现场体验。否则，车迷们会很快回到市里的酒店和餐厅，因为我们是在和市中心竞争。”
三级方程式（Formula 3）于八月底在该赛道进行了测试。
马德里能否兑现其承诺，顺利举办一届最多可容纳11万名观众的首届赛事，仍有待观察。最近有许多首届比赛成为学习机会的例子，包括迈阿密和拉斯维加斯。F1重返马德里很可能也会有不完善之处，但组织者表示他们已为此做好准备。
“这并不容易，”费尔南多·阿隆索（阿隆索）的前经纪人、现任该赛事总经理的路易斯·加西亚·阿巴德（Luis Garcia Abad）说，“我参与F1已经有25年了，我从没想过就你需要顾及的所有事情而言，会这么困难。”
“我一直与所有推广人交流，当你试图从零开始打造某样东西时，问题或多或少都是一样的。但IFEMA给我们提供了很多解决方案。我们本来没有赛道，但我们有Wi-Fi，有电力，主入口处还有地铁站。如果你试图在一个不同的场地组织赛事，那简直是一场噩梦。但有了这些（已经具备的）条件，我们得以把它建起来。”
“现在我们必须尽力提供我们能提供的最佳客户体验。”
detailEn: What to expect from F1's newest race as Madring debuts
For the first time in 45 years, Formula 1 will race in Madrid this weekend at the dual-natured Madring circuit
Madrid's 10-year tenure of the Spanish Grand Prix, taking over the moniker from the now biennial Barcelona race, is Formula 1's latest effort to bring its series to urban population centres.
It does so for 57 laps on a two-headed monster of a circuit that will take drivers and teams some time to wrap their collective engineering minds around.

Initial concept renderings of the so-called Madring drew mixed reactions with fears the Spanish GP's move from Barcelona's permanent circuit to the Valdebebas area near Madrid's main airport would see F1 add another generic street circuit, a concrete jungle that would soon be abandoned. One doesn't even have to look beyond the Spanish borders to evoke memories of the long-defunct Valencia grand prix, an uninspired flash in a paella-sized pan on what is now a ghost track.

Our first site visit in June suggested the circuit – originally designed by Dromo before the final stages of construction were handed over to Tilke – showed that the end product is certainly nowhere near as dramatic as that. But it certainly isn't like any other circuit on the calendar either.

The area around the start-and-finish straight is located around the IFEMA fairground concourse and public access roads, which certainly gives the first sector a stop-start feel reminiscent of the likes of Miami and Singapore.

The standout landmark, which features on the race official poster and other promotional material, is La Monumental; a long, fast banked corner featuring the maximum allowed 24% inclination. The 550-metre corner is much longer than Zandvoort's somewhat comparable final turn, as it draws a 270-degree arc around the northern, purpose-built end of the circuit.
The steep banking of La Monumental has a continuously changing gradient and elevation

The towering corner, which features a grandstand on the outside, made a staggering impression in person because of its continuous changes in gradient, radius and elevation that sets it apart from other banked corners on the calendar, or those found in oval races. There is no runoff, but the outside is lined with a SAFER barrier.

"It's a very, very special corner," Charles Leclerc said after exploring it during a dusty filming day with Ferrari. "It's a corner where I feel in qualifying we'll have to be very brave because it's going to be on the limit.

"I do believe it can become one of the most iconic corners of the season, especially with the grandstand. That will add to the experience of that corner. One thing is for sure, and that's that you will have to have full commitment."
That corner is followed by a number of high-speed direction changes with little run-off. As a red-flag-ridden F3 test suggested, the circuit will be tricky to handle in year one.

Early indications suggest that the Madring, if not an outright driver favourite, will be a respectable driving challenge in qualifying. The jury is still out on whether the circuit will be able to deliver a compelling spectacle, though. Because of its many braking zones, the circuit should sit in the middle of the pack in terms of energy-harvesting challenges. Overtaking does not look particularly easy, with the straight between Turns 3 and 5 the most obvious opportunity.

"It's going to be a very challenging track," Leclerc said diplomatically. "I don't know about the overtakes, I'm not sure there will be that many overtakes, I hope I'm wrong. But I think qualifying and the challenge of driving such a track is going to be one of the very cool ones of the season."
What Madrid can offer F1 that Barcelona still struggles with

Where Madrid wants to make a real difference is its accessibility. The circuit is not just a close drive from the airport, but is also connected to Madrid's extensive underground and commuter train network. The organisers promise hassle-free access to the circuit from anywhere in the capital, something which has long been a pain point in Barcelona.

In that respect it is exactly the type of venue that F1 management has become infatuated with. An urban race well integrated into a 'destination city', with all the amenities, baked-in mobility and sustainability solutions, and room for extensive VIP facilities.

"Well, you know better than me that coming in and out of a traditional circuit is a nightmare. Here we have both the metro in the south and the commuter train in the north, which is going to be extremely convenient," IFEMA's COO Carlos Jimenez promised. "Both are very fast lines with very few stops because they were designed to quickly connect the airport with the city centre. So, the experience for the fans to reach the circuit, we think it's going to be a difference-maker.

"It's very convenient, but the counterpart is that it obliges us to work harder to provide a good experience. Otherwise, the fans will quickly go back to the hotels and restaurants in the city, because we are competing with the city centre."
Formula 3 conducted a track test at the circuit at the end of August

Whether or not Madrid can make good on its promise to organise a smooth inaugural edition of its event, for a maximum capacity of 110,000 spectators, remains to be seen. There have been many recent examples of year one being a learning opportunity, including Miami and Las Vegas. F1's return to Madrid will likely be rough around the edges, too, but the organisers say they are prepared for that.

"It's not easy," said Luis Garcia Abad, Fernando Alonso's former manager and now the managing director of the event. "I have been involved in F1 for the last 25 years and I never thought that it was going to be so difficult in terms of all the things that you have to be aware of.

"I have been speaking with all the promoters, and the problems are more or less the same when you are trying to build something from scratch. But IFEMA gave us a lot of solutions. We didn't have a racetrack, but we had Wi-Fi, we had energy, we had a metro station at the main entrance. If you are trying to organise something in a different circuit, it's a nightmare. But with all these parameters [already in place], we were able to build it.
"Now we have to deliver the best customer experience we can."

这条全长3.365英里的马德里赛道（马德里赛道）共有22个官方弯道，不过不寻常的是赛道布局中包含了5A号弯和20A号弯——所以也许实际上有24个弯道。
无论具体号码是多少，在起终点直道之后，车手几乎总会在某个时刻转动方向盘，因为这条赛道几乎没有直道。
1号和2号组成的左右减速弯是整条赛道上为数不多的超车点之一，因为这里有一段很重的刹车区，随后经过3号和4号弯的长距离全油门路段，驶向可以说是自2008年至2012年新加坡大奖赛使用的老“新加坡甩尾”减速弯（Singapore Sling）以来一级方程式中最别扭的一个减速弯。
车手在5号弯能用到多少速度、能压上多少路肩，将是这条赛道的关键点之一。如果赛车并排进入5号弯前的路段，请屏住呼吸，因为那里根本容不下两辆赛车并排通过。然而，减速弯之前那段长长的全油门区域意味着车手会渴望在这里尝试超车……
在那之后，赛道上下起伏，进入7号弯一个非常棘手的上坡刹车区，在那里我们可能会看到车手擦碰到外侧的护栏。
赛道随后向左、向右、再向左转弯，到了排位赛时，由于练习赛中已经留下大量橡胶使赛道干净，这段或许可以全油门通过。
接下来是12号弯，它有可能成为标志性弯角，名为“拉蒙纽门塔尔（La Monumental）”。这是一个巨大的倾角弯道，以百分之二十四的坡度（13.5度）完成180度转弯，车手将在承受巨大横向G力的同时，尽量长时间保持全油门。
在13号弯向左轻摆之后，接下来的几个弯应该都可以全油门通过，直到来到17号弯这个90度的右弯，随后车手高速穿越18号和19号弯，再重刹进入20号弯这个急促的左弯。
最后一个弯即22号弯，是一个90度右弯，内侧护栏向外突出，因此车手在驶上主直道完成一圈过山车般的单圈时，需要小心不要过多切弯心，排位赛中这一圈预计用时约90秒。
法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔，加上威廉姆斯的卡洛斯·塞恩斯，是仅有的几位有过在这条赛道驾驶经验的车手。
塞恩斯是马德里环形赛道（马德里赛道）的形象大使，并对12号弯“La Monumental”倾斜弯道提出了意见，以便赛道设计者能够确保其安全性，同时保留独特性。
勒克莱尔说：“这是一个非常、非常特别的弯角。在这个弯角，我感觉在排位赛中，我们得——我用礼貌的方式说——我们必须非常勇敢，因为它将达到极限。
“所以我觉得那会非常酷。它将是一个非常酷的弯角。我相信它可以成为本赛季最具标志性的弯角之一，尤其是等看台建成之后。我认为那也会为这个弯角的体验增添色彩。”
甲骨文红牛车队将沥青路面换成了地下空间，标志性的 小红牛8 赛车驶上了马德里地铁的轨道，进行了一场史无前例的特技表演
勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿在七月进行了一次拍摄日，当时赛道刚刚完工，所以天气极其炎热，尘土飞扬。
汉密尔顿说："正如你所预料的那样，赛道完全没有抓地力。所以你的轮胎基本上全程都覆盖着灰尘。"
"这条赛道看起来会是那种适合排位赛单圈的赛道，而且几乎没有任何直道。所以这里看起来会是一个很难超车的地方。"
首次一睹 F1 最新赛道——马德里赛道 的真容
在赛道的大部分路段，如果车手因为转弯时机不对或车速稍微快了一点而稍稍偏离了赛车线，他们很可能就会高速撞上护栏。
风险与回报的赌注将非常高，而那些最大胆、并且把事情做对的车手将会笑到最后。
塞恩斯说：“我认为，考虑到他们设置护墙的方式以及这条赛道的设计，它肯定会成为最近一级方程式（Formula 1）中最大的挑战之一。”
“这条赛道让我想起很多吉达，让我想起很多巴库，在某些方面甚至还有点像澳门。所以开着有1000马力的一级方程式赛车在这里跑，将会是一个非常有趣的挑战，让我们看看会怎样吧。”
那么我们会遇到安全车和红旗吗？
简而言之，几乎可以肯定会。这条赛道难度极高，问题只是我们在练习赛、排位赛和正赛中会看到多少次红旗。正如我们在意大利大奖赛上看到的那样，如果任何护栏因撞车需要维修，那肯定需要出示红旗。
在为期两天的F3测试中，共出现了19次红旗——尽管并非全部都是因为撞车。
赛恩斯说：“看看这条赛道，再听听F3测试中发生的情况，我想大家都预计在排位赛中会看到安全车、红旗和黄旗，诸如此类的情况。”
“一级方程式最近有一种潮流或趋势，就是去往像吉达、巴库这类更贴近市中心的赛道——还有迈阿密——但那些地方护墙更多，而我们并没有遇到任何问题。实际上我们去过的每一个地方，比赛看起来都进行得相当顺利，所以这正是我们正在延续的类似趋势。”

The Spanish Grand Prix has moved from its traditional circuit in Barcelona to a high-speed street track in Madrid and has been described as "Jeddah on steroids" by Formula 3 drivers who tested there last month - the Jeddah track itself is one of the most challenging circuits in F1.
So why is the Madring so difficult and how will it impact the racing we see this weekend, live on Sky Sports F1?

There are 22 official corners on the 3.365-mile Madring circuit, although unusually the track layout has Turns 5A and 20A - so maybe there are 24.
Whatever the number, after the start/finish straight the driver will almost always be turning the steering wheel at some point as there are few straights.

The left-right chicane of Turns 1 and 2 is one of just a few overtaking spots thanks to its heavy braking zone before a long blast through Turns 3 and 4 towards arguably the most awkward chicane in F1 since the old 'Singapore Sling' chicane which was used at the Singapore Grand Prix between 2008 and 2012.

Just how much speed and how much kerb the drivers can use at Turn 5 will be a critical point of the circuit. If cars go side by side approaching Turn 5, hold your breath, because you cannot fit two cars through there alongside each other. However, the long flat-out zone before the chicane means drivers will be keen to make an overtake here...
After that, the track goes up and down into a really tricky uphill braking zone of Turn 7 where we may see drivers glancing the barriers on the outside.
The track then veers left, right and left, which may be flat out come qualifying when the track is clean after plenty of rubber has gone down from the practice sessions.

Then comes, what could become iconic, Turn 12, known as La Monumental. A huge banked corner that turns 180 degrees at 24 per cent gradient (13.5 degrees) where the drivers will try to stay hard on the throttle as much as possible while experiencing massive G-forces.

After a left-hand flick at Turn 13, the next few corners should be flat out until you arrive at a 90-degree right hander of Turn 17 before the drivers dance through Turns 18 and 19 at high speed, then hit the brakes into a sharp left hander at Turn 20.

The last corner of Turn 22 is a 90-degree right hander where the inside barriers jut out, so the drivers will need to be careful not to cut the apex too much as they arrive on the main straight to complete a rollercoaster lap which should be around 90 seconds in qualifying.
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc, plus Williams' Carlos Sainz are the only drivers to have any experience of driving the circuit.
Sainz is a Madring ambassador and gave input on the Turn 12 La Monumental banking so track designers could ensure it is safe, while still being unique.

Leclerc said: "It's a very, very special corner. It's a corner where I feel in qualifying, we'll have to, I will say it in a polite way, but we'll have to be very brave because it's going to be on the limit.

"And so that's going to be really cool, I think. It's going to be a really cool corner. I do believe it can become one of the most iconic corners of the season, especially once the grandstand will be built. I think that will add also to the experience of that corner."

Leclerc and Hamilton conducted a filming day in July when the track had only just finished its completion, so it was extremely hot and dusty.
"As you would expect, there was no grip. So your tyres were basically just covered in dust, and that's the whole time," said Hamilton.
"It looks like it will be a qualifying lap sort of circuit, and there's not really any straights. So it looks like a difficult place to overtake."
A first look at F1's newest circuit - the Madring

For much of the track, if the drivers are slightly off the racing line by turning at the wrong time or carrying a little too much speed, they could easily find themselves in the barriers at high speed.
The risk-versus-reward stakes will be very high and the bravest drivers, who get it right, will come out on top.
"I think definitely with the way they've put the barriers and the design of the track it's going to be one of the biggest challenges in Formula 1 recently," said Sainz.

"The track reminds me a lot of Jeddah, it reminds me a lot of Baku, even reminds me a bit of Macau in some ways. So having that in an F1 [car] with 1,000 horsepower is going to be quite an interesting challenge, so let's see how it goes."
So we are going to get safety cars and red flags?

In short, almost certainly. Such is the difficulty of the track, it is a question of how many red flags will we see across practice, qualifying and the race. As we saw at the Italian Grand Prix, if any barriers need to be repaired for crashes, that will definitely require a red flag.
In the two-day F3 test, there were 19 red flags - albeit not all of them were for crashes.
"Looking at the track and hearing of what happened in the F3 test, I think we are all expecting safety cars, red flags and yellow flags in qualy and things like this," said Sainz.

"It has been a fashion or a tendency of Formula 1 to go to these kind of tracks like Jeddah, Baku recently that are closer to the city - and Miami - but they have more walls and we haven't had any issues with it. The races actually seem to be going quite well to every place we've gone, so it's that similar trend we're going towards."

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯借助ADUO机制推进引擎升级，法拉利争冠前景受冲击
items.summaryZh: 据Jon Noble报道，梅赛德斯正借助F1的ADUO追赶机制推进一项引擎升级，可能对法拉利日渐黯淡的2026年争冠前景造成致命打击。

media.altZh: 梅赛德斯借助ADUO机制推进引擎升级，法拉利争冠前景受冲击

items.originalTitle: 梅赛德斯新引擎升级计划对法拉利构成重大打击
items.summaryEn: Jon Noble reports that Mercedes is working on an engine upgrade under F1's ADUO catch-up mechanism that could deal a killer blow to Ferrari's fading 2026 title chances.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯正在酝酿一次可能对竞争对手法拉利日渐渺茫的2026年F1冠军希望构成致命打击的引擎升级，该升级借助ADUO机制，即将投入使用。
尽管围场内普遍公认梅赛德斯拥有最完整的动力单元整体方案，但该车队已根据F1的追赶机制——即“额外开发与升级机会”（ADUO）——获得了今年引入一次开发升级的权利。
这是因为国际汽联对各制造商的分析得出结论：以ADUO所依据的内燃机部分来衡量，红牛领先其他所有厂商超过2%。
这意味着梅赛德斯有权在本赛季进行一次动力单元升级，并在2027年再进行一次；而法拉利、奥迪和本田则可以今年进行两次、明年再进行两次。红牛目前则不被允许进行任何改进。
梅赛德斯在本赛季早些时候曾表示，虽然它会利用通过ADUO获得的额外测试台架时间和研发支出，但它并不计划引入任何硬件改动。
然而，The 比赛获悉，计划现在已有改变，梅赛德斯的Brixworth发动机工厂正在进行各项工作，以在本赛季结束前推出一个ADUO升级版本。
升级版发动机的引入时间尚未最终确定，但预计很可能在即将到来的阿塞拜疆、马来西亚和新加坡三连赛期间的某个时点。
这一时机可能与乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）因启用全新动力单元部件而不得不接受发车退后处罚的时间相吻合，因为他现有的发动机储备无法撑到赛季结束。
梅赛德斯ADUO升级将在哪个区域进行尚未得到确认，但意大利大奖赛上基米·安东内利（安东内利）引入了哪些新部件、没有引入哪些新部件，可能提供了一个重要线索。
这位车手积分榜领跑者在进入他的主场之战前就知道，由于更换发动机的处罚，他将从发车区的最后一位起步。
然而，梅赛德斯没有选择安装一套全新的动力单元，而是将更换限制在安东内利的内燃机、电池和控制电子设备上。
车队没有安装新的涡轮增压器、MGU-K、排气系统和附属部件，尽管更换这些新部件本来不会带来任何额外后果。
推迟引入全套组件，这表明梅赛德斯计划在本赛季晚些时候引入这些部件——到那时，任何这些部件在安装时都还有升级的机会。
人们普遍认为，梅赛德斯通过改进其内燃机（ICE）几乎没有什么收益，而且这样做有可能使其领先于红牛，从而给对手创造使用研发配额的机会。
改进很可能集中在其他领域，其中涡轮增压器是最明显的、可以带来可观收益的部分。
由于梅赛德斯在意大利站采取的策略（即没有更换某些部件），首次引入全新涡轮增压器将不会受到处罚。
因此，当任何ADUO步骤到来时，这可能意味着Russell和Antonelli同时获得它。
根据F1的规则，如果制造商引入一项规格升级，那么该升级必须提供给它旗下的客户车队。
在该升级首次亮相的分站赛上，厂队必须向每支客户车队提供至少一个版本的改动。
因此，当新部件到来时，阿尔派、梅赛德斯和威廉姆斯都将享有所取得的任何进步，即使他们必须选择如何最好地在各自车手之间错开引入时间。
这也可能影响到前沿的争夺战，迈凯伦近期的进步帮助它赢得了比赛，而它可能获得的任何收益都将使其对法拉利拥有进一步的优势。
梅赛德斯ADUO升级的到来，很可能与一次重大赛车升级的时间相近，这次升级预计将在下月初于马来西亚举行的巴林大奖赛上推出。
由于车队今年在研发投入上采取了保守策略，它选择将重大新部件的推出时间间隔拉开。
车队上次推出重大升级套件是在5月底的蒙特利尔，目前正在为雪邦开发可能是一次大规模改革的方案。
汉密尔顿表示梅赛德斯的优势“令人难以置信”
梅赛德斯计划带来一次ADUO升级，这对法拉利来说是个坏消息，后者已在意大利大奖赛上引入了其两次允许升级中的第二次。
据了解，法拉利为提升引擎动力所做的改动与涡轮有关——将设计放大，并对概念进行了其他一些修改，以帮助挖掘其潜力。
法拉利此前淡化了其ADUO 2升级的重要性，哈斯车队的Ollie Bearman也使用了这套升级参赛。
然而，从法拉利与梅赛德斯在蒙扎直道上的相对表现可以清楚地看出，双方之间仍存在很大的差距。
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔（Fred Vasseur）表示，车队没有足够的能量来进行真正的对抗，因为对手们采用了不同的能量释放策略。
他说：“[有些车]在一条直道上快10公里/小时，在另一条直道上又慢10公里/小时。问题在于我们几乎在所有地方都慢了10公里/小时。
“当我们在一个弯角多投入一些能量时，接下来一条直道上的差距反而更大。这几乎无法管理。”
刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示，他自己的法拉利与梅赛德斯之间的差距让他感到震惊。
"我们知道他们在直道上很快，但他们在直道上究竟有多快真是令人难以置信，"他说。"梅赛德斯的动力，那玩意儿就是不断地拉、拉、拉。"
尽管瓦塞尔指出了能量部署不足是比赛中的一大限制因素，但他表示，法拉利整体表现不佳并没有明显的根本原因。
"当你缺乏纯粹的动力时，你就得通过调整部署来试图在一条直道上进行补偿，"他说。
“如果你在某处部署得更多，那肯定就会在别处部署得更少。然后在战斗中你就是在陷入一个错误的螺旋，试图去玩弄这个。”
“说实话，这不是关于部署的问题。我认为部署是好的。就连迈凯伦，他们也在周五和周六早上做了一点尝试。归根结底，我们缺少的是纯粹的动力。”
尽管蒙扎的升级是法拉利本赛季进行的第二步改进，此前6月在奥地利引入了修改，但瓦塞尔认为，引擎更改所需的长周期意味着与梅赛德斯抗衡将是一个长期项目。
“我们并没有指望靠ADUO 1或ADUO 2就实现追赶，”他说。“我们正在小步前进，但必须记住的是……哪怕只提升几匹马力，对发车位置来说也是很好的一步。”
detailEn: Mercedes is working on what could be a killer blow to rival Ferrari's fading 2026 Formula 1 title chances with an ADUO-assisted engine upgrade set for introduction.

Despite it being accepted in the paddock that Mercedes has the best complete power unit package, it has earned the right to bring a development step this year under F1's catch-up mechanism known as Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO).

That is because the FIA's analysis of the different manufacturers has concluded that, based on the internal combustion engine element that ADUO is judged on, Red Bull is more than 2% ahead of everybody else.

It means Mercedes has the right to bring one power unit upgrade this season and one in 2027, while Ferrari, Audi and Honda can bring two this year and two next. Red Bull is not allowed any improvements yet.

Mercedes had declared earlier this season that, while it would be making use of the extra test bench hours and development spending that has been opened to it through ADUO, it did not plan to introduce any hardware changes.
However, The Race has learned that there has now been a change of plan and that efforts are ongoing at Mercedes' Brixworth engine facility to ready an ADUO step before the end of the campaign.

No date has yet been set in stone for the introduction of the upgraded specification, but it is anticipated that it will likely be at some point during the upcoming triple header that comprises Azerbaijan, Malaysia and Singapore.

The timing of this could coincide with when George Russell has to take a grid drop penalty for fresh power unit components, with him unable to get through to the end of the season on his current pool.

It has not been confirmed in what area the Mercedes ADUO modifications will be made, but a big clue may have come at the Italian Grand Prix through the new parts Kimi Antonelli did and did not introduce there.
The world championship leader had headed into his home race knowing that he would be starting from the back of the grid because of an engine change penalty.
However, Mercedes chose not to fit a totally new power unit and instead restricted the changes to Antonelli's internal combustion engine, battery and control electronics.
It did not fit a fresh turbo, MGU-K, exhaust and ancillaries, even though taking new versions of these would have been without consequence.
Holding fire on introducing the full suite of components suggests Mercedes plans to bring those parts later this season – with the door then open for any of these to be upgraded when they are fitted.
It is widely understood that Mercedes has little to gain through improving its ICE, and that doing so risks pulling it ahead of Red Bull and handing its rival an opportunity for ADUO.
Modifications are likely to be focused in other areas, with the turbo the most obvious area where good gains can be found.
Due to Mercedes' tactics in Italy, in terms of what it did not replace, bringing the first fresh turbo will be without penalty.
So, when any ADUO step comes then that could mean both Russell and Antonelli getting their hands on it at the same time.
Under F1's rules, if a manufacturer introduces an upgrade of specification, then this has to be made available to its customer teams.
At the first race where it comes, the works squad must make at least one version of the change available to each of its customer teams.
So, when the new part comes, Alpine, Mercedes and Williams will all enjoy any progress that has been made, even if they have to choose how best to stagger any introduction between their drivers.
This could have an impact on the fight at the front too, with McLaren's recent progress having helped it win races and any gain it has potentially giving it a further edge over Ferrari.
The arrival of the Mercedes ADUO upgrade will likely come around the time of a major car upgrade that looks set to arrive at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia at the start of next month.
With the team having been conservative with its development spending this year, it has elected to space out its introduction of major new parts.
It last introduced a major package in Montreal in late May, but is working on what could be a big overhaul for Sepang.
Hamilton says Mercedes advantage 'mind blowing'
Mercedes' plan to bring an ADUO upgrade will be bad news for Ferrari, which introduced the second of its two allowed upgrades at the Italian Grand Prix.

It is understood that the changes it made to try to improve engine power were related to the turbo – making the design bigger with some other modification to the concept aimed at helping its potential.
Ferrari had downplayed the significance of its ADUO 2 step, which was also raced by Haas's Ollie Bearman.
However, it was clear from the relative performance of Ferrari against Mercedes on Monza's straights that there remains a big differential in play.
Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur said that his team did not have the energy available to fight properly, as rivals battled with different deployment strategies.
"[Some] were 10km/h faster on one straight and 10km/h slower on another," he said. "The issue was that we were almost 10km/h slower everywhere.
"When we were putting a bit more energy in one corner, the gap was even bigger in the next straight line. It was quite impossible to manage."
Lewis Hamilton said he was taken aback by the differences between his own Ferrari and the Mercedes.
"We knew that they were fast on the straight, but it was really mind-blowing just how quick they were on the straight," he said. "Mercedes power, that thing just keeps pulling, pulling, pulling."
Despite Vasseur singling out the deployment deficit as a limiting factor in the race, he said there was no obvious root cause for the overall poor Ferrari performance.
"When you have a lack of pure power, then you start to play with deployment to try to compensate in one straight line," he said.
"If you deploy more somewhere, for sure you will deploy less somewhere else. And then you are going in the wrong spiral to try to play with this when you are fighting.
"Honestly, it's not about deployment. I think deployment was good. Even McLaren, they were playing a little bit Friday and Saturday morning. At the end, we are missing pure power."

Despite the Monza upgrade being the second step that Ferrari has made this season, following the revisions introduced in Austria in June, Vasseur thinks the long lead times for engine changes means getting on terms with Mercedes will be a long-term project.

"We were not expecting to recover [with] ADUO 1 or ADUO 2," he said. "We are doing small steps, but what you have to keep in mind is that…even if you make a couple of horsepower, it's a good step on the grid.

items.titleZh: 维特尔驾驶舒马赫2002年冠军法拉利背后的更深层意义
items.summaryZh: 乔恩·诺布尔撰文指出，塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔在意大利大奖赛驾驶迈克尔·舒马赫2002年冠军赛车F2002，不仅带有情感色彩，还传递了另一层信息。
items.originalTitle: 维特尔驾驶舒马赫冠军法拉利的更深层意义
items.summaryEn: Jon Noble writes that Sebastian Vettel's run in Michael Schumacher's 2002 championship-winning F2002 at the Italian Grand Prix carried more meaning than just an emotional demonstration of famous machinery.
detailZh: 塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔坦率地表示，上周末在意大利大奖赛上驾驶迈克尔·舒马赫2002年赢得F1冠军的法拉利F2002，不仅仅是对这台著名赛车的简单展示。
一方面是其中的情感因素，维特尔坐进了曾经属于他童年偶像、后来成为朋友的赛车座舱。
"我们之间的友谊让我们有着深厚的联系，我们走得很近，共享了许多美好的回忆，"他这样评价舒马赫。
"我们更希望看到的是他开车，而不是我，我自己也一样。"
但这场表演赛还有一个额外的作用，就是为当前关于F1未来究竟应该是什么样的争论火上浇油。
因为尽管2026年的规则无论是有意设计还是偶然所致，都带来了一些精彩的比赛，但维特尔表示，F1的意义不仅仅是超车。
"比赛确实令人兴奋，比赛本身很精彩，但当你审视F1时，还有太多东西值得深入探讨，"他在蒙扎说道。
"当然，从车手的角度来看，我想驾驶最好的赛车，我想赢得比赛。可是，什么才是最好的赛车呢？
"2002年的那辆车在当时是最先进的，是一个先驱者，它代表了F1所蕴含的许多精神。"
"如今的赛车同样如此，我认为这关乎性能、精准、纪律和努力工作，同时也关乎责任感和将这种精神传承下去。"
"还有对未来的关怀，你知道这些赛车正在努力做到这一点。"
"在人们对2026年规则的影响看法不一的这一年过半之际，维特尔表示，F2002的展示意在提醒人们F1的本质可以是什么。"
“从驾驶角度来看，对于目前的[2026]规则，我可能并不完全认同其中的一切，”他解释道。
“但展望未来，我认为这是一个让更多人参与进来的巨大机会。
“而且也许还可以借此契机，提醒人们这项运动曾经是什么、现在是什么，以及它未来应该成为、也能够成为什么。并且要以负责任的方式去做。”
维特尔并不喜欢F1的涡轮增压混合动力规则，尽管作为一名热衷环保的人士，他也清楚这类动力单元在可持续性方面的好处。他曾多次质疑这一切与民用车之间真正的相关性。
正是这一立场促使他在几年前，在2022年英国大奖赛上驾驶尼格尔·曼塞尔1992年的FW14B进行演示跑之后，成为最早提出以下建议的人之一：与其让F1变得更加电动化，不如反其道而行之。
随着可持续燃料的发展——在那次FW14B演示跑中以及上周末在蒙扎都有使用——一扇大门反而被打开，未来有可能回归V8或V10发动机。
尽管F1起初对这个想法泼了冷水，但时代已经变了。复杂性、成本以及对新的50/50规则的反馈共同使得F1和国际汽联都确信，这将是这类涡轮增压混合动力赛车的最后一套规则。
国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆已经宣布，F1最迟将在2031年转用V8发动机，尽管仍会保留一小部分电动元素。
对于Vettel来说，他对自己设想的可持续燃料/V8未来的构想获得认可，这是他所欢迎的——但他表示，如果认为这一单一转变就能奇迹般地治愈F1的所有弊病，那就错了。
"没有任何一种方法能解决所有问题，"他说。"围场里有很多我认识的人，包括我自己曾经也是其中之一，都在寻找灵丹妙药。
"你想要某种能推动你前进、给你带来优势的东西。但这从来不是某一件事能实现的。它总是多种因素的组合。
"我认为，从F1和赛车运动的角度来看，可持续燃料是向前迈进的一步。它有着巨大的潜力，不仅对F1而言，还能激励其他赛车系列赛。
"那么，如果你来塑造下一代赛车，就有很大的潜力去负责任地这样做，因为从技术角度来看也许令人难以置信的一些东西，未必能够应用到街道上。所以，我认为这样做也是一种责任。"
"如果已经不再有这样的机会，那么也许你必须达到一个境界，乐于做减法、简化。"
"你可以通过不同的方式、在不同的赛道上实现负责任和树立榜样——不仅仅是赛道上，甚至可以是赛道旁边【也就是街道上】。"
正是通过新技术和简化，回归到过去一些核心魅力的这种潜力，让Vettel相信，他驾驶F2002的这次运行所带来的影响，证明了为什么复古路线的F1未来可以是光明的。
“我期待未来以及未来带来的一切，因为我认为F1有许多美好的价值观，塑造了我并激励了我的人生，”他说。
它触动着世界各地许多人，并且拥有这样的力量，能够在许多其他有意义、有影响力的事情上发挥作用。
detailEn: Sebastian Vettel was quite open that his run in Michael Schumacher's 2002 Formula 1 championship-winning F2002 at last weekend's Italian Grand Prix was about more than just a demonstration of famous machinery.
On the one hand were the emotions of it all, with Vettel stepping into a cockpit once occupied by one of a childhood hero and, later, friend.
"We had a deep connection with the friendship, got fairly close and shared so many nice memories," he said of Schumacher.
"We'd much rather see him drive than me, myself included."
But there was an added element of the demonstration helping stoke the flames on a current debate about what F1 should really be in the future.
Because while the 2026 rules have, whether through design or by accident, produced some spectacular racing, Vettel said F1 is about more than just overtaking.
"It is exciting, the racing is exciting, but there's so much more to unpack when you look at F1," he said at Monza.
"Of course, from a driver's point of view, I want to drive the best car, and I want to win races. But then, what is the best car?
"The car of 2002 was state-of-the-art at that time, and a pioneer, and represents so much for what F1 stands for.
"The cars today do the same, and I think it's about performance, precision, discipline, hard work, but also responsibility and taking that forward.
"Also caring about the future, which you know these cars are trying to do."
Midway through a year in which opinions have been divided over the impact of the 2026 rules, Vettel argued that the F2002 run was something to remind people of what the essence of F1 could be.
"I'm probably not agreeing on everything that we currently have in the [2026] regulations from a driving point of view," he explained.
"But looking forward, I think that's where there's a huge chance to take people on board.
"And maybe also, for a moment like this, remind them what the sport was, what the sport is, and what the sport should be and can be in the future. And to do it responsibly."

Vettel is not a fan of F1's turbo hybrid rules, even though as a keen environmentalist he is aware of the sustainable benefits from such power units. He has often questioned the true road relevance of it all.

This stance was what prompted him to be one of the very first to suggest a few years ago, following a demonstration run in Nigel Mansell's 1992 FW14B at the 2022 British GP, that rather than F1 becoming more electric, the opposite would be better.
With the growth of sustainable fuels - used in that FW14B run and last weekend at Monza - a door instead was open for a return to V8s or V10s in the future.

While F1 initially poured cold water on that idea, times have changed. The complexities, costs and response to the new 50/50 rules have come together to leave both F1 and the FIA convinced that this will be the final ruleset for turbo hybrids like this.
FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem has declared that F1 will be moving to V8s by 2031 at the latest, even though a small electrical element will remain.

For Vettel, the acceptance of his vision for a sustainable fuel/V8 future is something he welcomed - but he said it would be wrong to think that this singular shift will be a miracle cure for all of F1's ills.
"There is nothing you can apply that will fix all the problems," he said. "There are a lot of people in the paddock that I know, and I've been one of them, to look for the silver bullet.
"You want something that propels you forward and gives you an advantage. But it's never one single thing. It's always a combination of a lot of things.
"I think sustainable fuels are a step forward when you look at F1 and racing. There's huge potential, not just for F1, but also to inspire other racing series.

"Then if you shape the next generation of cars, there's a lot of potential to do so responsibly, because some things that are maybe incredible from a technology point of view might not be transferable to the streets. So, I think there's also responsibility to do that.
"And if there is not that chance anymore, then maybe you have to get to a point where you are happy to simplify.
"You can achieve being responsible and setting an example in different ways and on different tracks, not just the racetrack, but even just next to the racetrack [on the streets]."

It's the potential to return to some of the core attractions of the past, through both new technology and simplification, that has left Vettel convinced the impact of his F2002 run is proof of why an old-school F1 future can be bright.
"I look forward to the future and what it brings, because I think F1 has so many nice values that shaped me and inspired me in my life," he said.
"It touches a lot of people around the world and has that power to do so on many other things that are meaningful and impactful."

items.titleZh: Toto Wolff：安东内利像不断进化的“AI智能体”
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队负责人Toto Wolff表示，安东内利在2026年F1赛季的快速成长令他自己都感到惊讶，并将其比作一个始终在进步的“AI智能体”。

media.altZh: Toto Wolff：安东内利像不断进化的“AI智能体”

items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff：Kimi Antonelli像不断进化的“AI智能体”
items.summaryEn: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff admits that even he has been surprised by Kimi Antonelli's rapid growth during the 2026 F1 season, likening the young Italian to an "AI agent" that is always improving.
detailZh: 据托托·沃尔夫（Toto Wolff）表示，基米·安东内利（安东内利）就像一个不断进步的“AI智能体”。
这位年轻的意大利车手在他的主场大奖赛上取得了一场统治级的胜利，梅赛德斯车队领队认为这凸显了他在F1中的飞速成长。
梅赛德斯领队托托·沃尔夫承认，连他自己也对基米·安东内利在2026年F1赛季中展现出的快速进步感到惊讶，并把他比作一个不断自我提升的“AI智能体”。
这位20岁的意大利车手目前仅处于他的第二个F1赛季，此前在2025赛季开始前，刘易斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）离开银箭车队，他因此被火速提拔至顶级赛事作为接替者。
在第一年里，Antonelli 经历了一场起伏不定的赛季，在欧洲站的比赛中尤其挣扎。这使一些旁观者开始质疑 Wolff 提拔这位年轻车手的决定，但他始终坚持这一选择。
“去年是符合计划的，”这位奥地利人说道。“我说过会有惊艳的时刻，也会有艰难的时刻。”
“我认为他赛季开始的时候，有些像被车灯照住的鹿。在他的领域里，在车里，他已经有了非凡的表现，但还不够持续。”
“然后他经历了一段低谷，连续九场比赛没有拿到积分。我记得 Spa 对他来说很糟糕，他情绪低落。Monza 是我第一次对他说‘听着，你该醒醒了’的节点。但我从未怀疑过。这就是我们给他这个机会的原因。”
安东内利 在2025年与梅赛德斯的首个赛季过得颇为艰难。
然而，冬歇期之后，随着F1进入新时代，大起大落的成绩不复存在，梅赛德斯也从艰难争夺领奖台一跃成为再次争夺总冠军的车队。
随着车队表现的提升，Antonelli 自己的成绩也实现了飞跃，这位意大利车手目前在F1积分榜上领先队友 拉塞尔，后者落后66分。Wolff 承认，这一局面连他都感到震惊。
“冬歇期后他一出场，起步之好出乎所有人的意料，”Wolff 说，“他的能力，以及他消化去年经历的方式。他参加了所有比赛，见识过媒体的压力，也感受过他所受到的关注。这些都被系统性地消化并储存了下来。这就是为什么之后有了我们所看到的那些成绩。”
“但看到他进步得如此之快，仍然令人惊讶和赞叹。对我来说，他就像一个不断自我改进和学习的AI智能体。这就是那种速度。”
“此外，他的年龄肯定也是优势。在认知和智力上，他具备不断提升的能力。”
托托·沃尔夫坚持他提拔基米·安东内利与乔治·拉塞尔搭档的决定
尽管他的成绩有了令人瞩目的转变——在蒙扎，他在接受引擎罚退后从第19位一路冲到冠军就是明证——安东内利并没有因此自满。
他在每次获胜后都保持冷静，并在2026年偶尔犯错的少数情况下进行总结。如今，他领先经验更丰富的队友一大截，Antonelli表示他只是顺其自然地看待这个赛季。
“我只是一场一场地比，因为你永远不知道会发生什么，”Antonelli在意大利大奖赛结束后告诉天空体育。“今天进展顺利，我们获得了一个巨大的机会，我们抓住了它，当然，下周我们要去马德里，这将是一个新的挑战。
“我们必须保持最佳状态，因为这对每个人来说都是一条新赛道，保持精准至关重要，这样才能最大限度地利用赛道时间和一切资源。
“我会享受当下这一刻，然后专注于下一场比赛，接着再专注于再下一场，直到赛季结束。”
F1 将于本周末重返赛场，迎来西班牙大奖赛，该赛事将从其传统的巴塞罗那赛道移师全新的马德里林（马德里赛道）赛道举行。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli like “AI agent" that's always getting better, according to Toto Wolff
The young Italian took a commanding victory at his home race, which the Mercedes boss believes highlights his rapid development in F1

Mercedes boss Toto Wolff admits that even he has been surprised by the rapid growth shown by Kimi Antonelli over the course of the 2026 Formula 1 season, likening him to an "AI agent" that is always improving.
The 20-year-old Italian is in just his second F1 season after being fast-tracked to the top tier as a replacement for Lewis Hamilton when he left the Silver Arrows ahead of the 2025 season.

In his first year, Antonelli faced an up and down campaign, and struggled over the European rounds in particular. This led to some onlookers to question Wolff’s decision to promote the youngster, but he always stood by the move.
“Last year was according to plan,” the Austrian said. “I've said there are going to be moments of brilliance, difficult moments.
“I think he started the season at a time when he found himself like a deer in the headlights. In his zone, in the car, extraordinary performances already, but not continuous.

“Then he had this negative spell where he made over nine races without scoring points. I remember Spa was terrible for him and he was feeling down. Monza was the point where I for the first time said to him, 'listen, you've got to wake up here'. But never doubting. That's why we gave him the opportunity.”
Kimi Antonelli had a rough debut season with Mercedes in 2025

The topsy-turvy results were gone after the winter break, however, when F1 entered its new era and Mercedes made the jump from scrapping to make the podium to being a title-contending team once again.

Along with the improvement made to the team’s performance came a leap in Antonelli’s own results, and the Italian now leads the F1 standings over team-mate George Russell who lags 66 points behind. This, Wolff admits, came as a shock to even him.

"He came out after the winter, out of the blocks in a way that no one saw coming,” Wolff said. “The ability, how he processed last year. He's been at all the races. He's seen the pressure of the media, the attention that he gets. It's in a way that the system has been processed and saved. And that's why [he's had] the results that we've seen afterwards.
“But it is still surprising and amazing to see how quickly he develops. For me, it's like an AI agent that continuously self-improves and learns. That's the speed.
“Also his age is for sure beneficial. The ability cognitively, intellectually to constantly become better.”
Toto Wolff stands by his decision to promote Kimi Antonelli to partner George Russell
Despite the impressive turnaround in his results, which was exemplified in Monza where he charged to victory from 19th after taking an engine penalty, Antonelli isn’t getting ahead of himself.

He has remained calm after each victory and taken stock on the odd occasion that he has made mistakes in 2026. Now, with a substantial lead over his more experienced team-mate, Antonelli said he is just taking the season as it comes.

“I just take race by race because you never know what can happen,” Antonelli told Sky Sports after the Italian GP. “Today went well, we had a massive opportunity and we took it, but of course next week we have Madrid and it's going to be a new challenge.
“We will have to be on top of the game because it's a new track for everyone and it's going to be important to be on point in order to maximise the track time and everything.
“I'm going to enjoy this moment and then focus on the next one and then focus on the next one again until the end of the season.”
F1 will return to action this weekend with the Spanish Grand Prix, which moves from its traditional home in Barcelona to the new Madring circuit.

items.summaryZh: 在F1意大利大奖赛蒙扎站的比赛中，兰多·诺里斯被听到指责队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里将他逼出赛道，迈凯伦承认将在赛后审查两位车手的竞争条款。

items.originalTitle: 迈凯伦将在意大利大奖赛后“审查”诺里斯与皮亚斯特里的赛道竞争规则
items.summaryEn: During the F1 Italian Grand Prix at Monza, Lando Norris was heard accusing teammate Oscar Piastri of forcing him off track, and McLaren admitted it will review the terms of competition between the two drivers after the race.
detailZh: 迈凯伦将在意大利大奖赛后“审查”兰多·诺里斯与奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里之间的赛车方式
车队领队安德里亚·斯特拉表示，两位车手在比赛尾声阶段的争执是“无害的”，但承认内部争斗让车队付出了代价
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
在兰多·诺里斯被听到指责队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在F1意大利大奖赛中将他逼出赛道之后，迈凯伦承认将“审查”当两位车手在赛道上相遇时的交手规则。
在周日于蒙扎举行的53圈比赛中，皮亚斯特里从第六位发车，而诺里斯则排在第八位发车。比赛接近尾声时，两人开始为位置展开争夺，这位英国车手在第48圈率先超过队友，升至第四位。
皮亚斯特里在一圈之后夺回了位置，随后诺里斯在比赛仅剩几圈时试图再次夺回位置。当这位英国车手再次尝试超越皮亚斯特里时，他向左侧正在关闭的空当移动，结果空间不足，两个车轮压到了草地上，他认为皮亚斯特里“把我挤了出去”。
这次冲突引起了迈凯伦车队领队安德里亚·斯特拉的注意，他解释说，车队起初认为不必介入两位车手的争斗，因为车队希望坚持其“自由竞速的哲学”。
安德里亚·斯特拉表示，他的两位车手之间的这次事件是“无害的”。
斯特拉说：“两辆赛车使用的是同一种轮胎，轮胎寿命相同，赛车也一样，所以我们认为没有必要干预比赛的正常进程。我们让他们自由竞争。我们认为是正确的做法。
“当兰多把车轮压到草地上的时候，他通过无线电说了一句类似‘他把我挤出去’之类的话，但当我们回顾之后，我认为我们发现这一事件比当时情绪激动之下看起来要温和得多。
“所以，我认为这件事我们肯定会进行回顾，并且会结合这类比赛的情境来审视，因为我认为你指出的一点是对的：一旦车手之间互相缠斗，就可能损失时间。
“那么，迈凯伦当时有没有更好的方式去与（马克斯）维斯塔潘展开竞争？我们会回顾研究。在当时对我们维修墙上的团队来说这并不明显，而且我们认为按照我们‘放手去比赛’的理念，让他们自由竞争更为重要。
这支英国车队有在蒙扎站之后启动内部审查的历史。去年，当皮亚斯特里在比赛中被要求为诺里斯让车时，其臭名昭著的“木瓜规则”（papaya rules）被推到了聚光灯下。
尽管任何此类调查的结果尚未确定，斯特拉承认，他的车队在周日的比赛中几乎没有机会抵挡维斯塔潘。这位荷兰车手最终超越了迈凯伦的两辆赛车，与乔治·拉塞尔和比赛冠军基米·安东内利一同登上了领奖台的第三级。
“我认为总的来说马克斯更快，”斯特拉承认。“他只是陷入了今年特有的这种困境——在蒙扎这里一旦失去尾流，你就必须用能量去防守别人。”
detailEn: McLaren to "review" racing between Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri following Italian GP
Team boss Andrea Stella says the altercation between his drivers in the closing stages of the race was “benign”, but admits in-fighting cost the team
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren

After Lando Norris was heard accusing team-mate Oscar Piastri of forcing him off-track in the Formula 1 Italian Grand Prix, McLaren admits it will “review” its terms of engagement when the two drivers face one another on track.

In Sunday’s 53-lap race at Monza, Piastri started sixth while Norris lined up eighth. By the closing stages of the race, the pair had begun tussling for position as the Briton first passed his team-mate on lap 48 to take fourth.

Piastri took back the position a lap later, and Norris then attempted to re-take the position with less than a handful of laps remaining. As the Briton attempted to pass Piastri yet again, he moved for a closing gap on the left-hand side, ran out of room and dipped two wheels on the grass, suggesting Piastri "pushed me off".

The altercation caught the attention of McLaren team principal Andrea Stella, who explained that initially the team didn’t see fit to interfere in the pair’s race as it sought to stick to its “philosophy of going racing”.
Andrea Stella says the incident between his drivers was "benign"

“The two cars were on the same tyres, same tyre age, same car, so we thought there was no need to interfere with the normal development of the race,” Stella said. “We let them race. We think that was the right thing to do.

“The moment in which Lando put the wheels on the grass, he came on the radio, he made a comment like he pushed me off or something, but actually when we reviewed it, I think we saw that the episode is much more benign than what it might have looked in the heat of the moment.

“So, I think it's something that certainly we will review and we will review in the context of this kind of racing, because I think you are right in highlighting that as soon as you fight with each other, then you may lose time.

“So, was there a better way for McLaren to give a fight to [Max] Verstappen? We will review. It wasn't obvious to us at the pit wall, and we thought that it was more important to let them race according to our philosophy of going racing.”

The British team has a history of launching internal reviews following the Monza round. Last year, its infamous papaya rules were thrown into the spotlight when Piastri was ordered to let Norris by in the race.

Despite the impending outcome of any such inquiry, Stella admits that his team had little chance of defending from Verstappen in Sunday’s race. The Dutchman eventually passed both McLarens to take the third step on the podium alongside George Russell and race winner Kimi Antonelli.

“I think overall Max was faster,” Stella conceded. “He was just caught in this hook that you have this year when you lose the slipstream here in Monza and you have to use the energy to defend from someone else.”

法拉利推出了他们本赛季第二次也是最后一次引擎升级，但在直道上仍然比梅赛德斯动力的赛车慢。
直线速度一直是法拉利最大的弱点，而在新的多弯马德里赛道上这将不成问题，瓦塞尔表示他“没有指望”能弥补与梅赛德斯在动力单元上的差距。
“当你缺乏纯粹的动力时，你就会开始研究能量输出策略，试图在直道上进行弥补，”他说。
"但如果你在某些地方增加部署，肯定就会在其他地方减少部署。那么在战斗的时候，你就是在走向错误的螺旋，试图玩弄这个。"
"老实说，这不是部署的问题。即使是迈凯伦，他们在周五和周六早上也稍微玩了一些手段。归根结底，我们缺的是纯粹的动力。"
罗斯伯格表示，在这个赛季阶段，法拉利偏袒汉密尔顿是"不可行的"
在今年的第一次额外研发与升级机会（ADUO）审查之后，法拉利被判落后于基准发动机制造商红牛超过百分之四。
这意味着法拉利可以在今年进行两次引擎升级，并且在2027年也可以，届时这支车队（Scuderia）将拥有新引擎。
“引擎的研发过程非常漫长。底盘的话，你可以从一天到另一天很快地完成升级并追回节奏，”瓦塞尔（Vasseur）说。
“至于引擎，这个过程非常漫长，因为零部件的交付周期很长，而且成本上限也不容易应对——你必须为整个赛季生产引擎。”
汉密尔顿表示车队要实施任何形式的“法拉利优先”都“太晚了”
“而如果你想要开始进行研发，你就必须生产一批新的引擎。我们并不指望通过 ADUO 1 或 ADUO 2 来实现追赶。我们正在一小步一小步地前进。”
“如果你在引擎上迈出一小步，请记住，我们身后（的对手）只相差百分之几秒。就排位而言，即使只多出几匹马力，也是在发车格上迈出的好一步。明年我们将迎来一台新引擎。当然，目标就是尽快追上（对手）。”

Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur says his team will head to this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid with "all the energy" to bounce back from their "failure" at Monza.

There were big expectations for Ferrari at their home event after Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc were quick in Friday practice, only to miss out on the front row in qualifying before a dismal race on Sunday.
Hamilton dropped from fourth to 10th after going side by side with Leclerc at the first chicane, going through the gravel at Turn 2, which he was unhappy with.

"We will come to Madrid with all the energy that we need to do a good result," said Vasseur.

Vasseur: Ferrari missing pure power despite engine upgrade
Ferrari introduced their second and final engine upgrade of the season but were still slower than the Mercedes-powered cars on the straights.

Straight-line speed has been Ferrari's biggest weakness, something which will not be an issue around the new twisty Madrid circuit, and Vasseur says he was "not expecting" to make up the power-unit deficit to Mercedes.
"When you have a lack of pure power, then you start to play with deployment, to try to compensate in the straight line," he said.
"But if you deploy more somewhere, for sure you will deploy less somewhere else. Then you are going in the wrong spiral to try to play with this when you are fighting.
"Honestly, it's not about deployment. Even McLaren, they were playing a little bit Friday and Saturday morning. In the end, we are missing pure power."
Rosberg says it is 'not feasible' for Ferrari to favour Hamilton at this stage of the season
After the first Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO) review earlier this year, Ferrari were deemed to be more than four per cent behind benchmark engine manufacturer Red Bull.
It meant Ferrari could make two engine upgrades this year, and also for 2027, when the Scuderia will have a new engine.
"The process of the engine is mega long. The chassis you can make an upgrade from one day to the other very quickly and come back into the pace," said Vasseur.
"On the engine, the process is mega long because the lead time of the parts is long and the cost cap is not easy - you have to produce the engine for the season.

"And if you want to start to do the development, you have to produce a new batch of engines. We are not expecting to recover with ADUO 1 or ADUO 2. We are doing small steps.

"If you make a small step on the engine, keep in mind that behind us, it was hundredths of a second. In terms of position, even if you make a couple of horsepower, it's a good step on the grid. Now we will have a new engine next year. For sure, the target is to catch up as soon as possible."

items.titleZh: 为何加斯利式的F1杆位冷门正接近绝迹
items.summaryZh: 《The 比赛》撰文指出，皮埃尔·加斯利在意大利大奖赛夺杆是F1近期最大的冷门之一，而过去十年只有两名“四大车队”之外的车手拿到过杆位。
items.originalTitle: 为何加斯利式的F1杆位冷门正接近绝迹
items.summaryEn: Jon Noble writes that Pierre Gasly's pole position at the Italian Grand Prix was one of the biggest shocks Formula 1 has seen recently, noting that over the past decade only two drivers outside the big four teams have claimed pole.
detailZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利在意大利大奖赛上夺得的杆位，是近来一级方程式赛场上最大的一次冷门之一。
事实上，在过去十年里，除了目前四支强队梅赛德斯、迈凯伦、法拉利和红牛之外，只有两名车手拿到过杆位。
那是凯文·马格努森代表哈斯车队在2022年巴西大奖赛短距离赛排位赛（排位冲刺赛）中夺得的杆位，以及兰斯·斯特罗尔代表赛点车队在2020年土耳其大奖赛排位赛中拿下的头名。不过，这两次都是受到外部因素带来的额外不可预测性影响的结果。
在马格努森的情况下，是天气因素起了作用——排位赛尾声的一场倾盆大雨，让他早期的第三节短距离赛排位赛（SQ3）成绩无人能破。而对斯特罗尔来说，伊斯坦布尔极其湿滑的赛道表面带来了意外变数，而赛点车队恰好应对自如。
加斯利在蒙扎的高光时刻有些不同，因为这是在完全正常的干地条件下凭实力拿到的。
所有人之间的性能差距很小，想跑好排位赛单圈的关键在于执行力和赛道上的位置把握——而阿尔派在这方面做得完美，各大强队都因为各自的原因出了差错。
在正常的比赛周末推翻F1领先集团的事情确实发生过，比如菲利佩·马萨在2014年奥地利大奖赛拿到的杆位，或者马尔多纳多在精彩的2012年西班牙大奖赛周末拿到的杆位，这两次都是由威廉姆斯车队实现的，但这种情况极其罕见。
如果我们翻阅历史记录，这种不寻常的结果几乎已经绝迹了——从下面这张非四大强队的杆位统计表就可以看出来。
“四大车队”之外的车队最近获得的杆位，以及车队在车队年度总冠军榜上的排名
加斯利 - 阿尔派 - 2026年意大利大奖赛（目前第6名）
马格努森 - 哈斯 - 2022年巴西大奖赛（第8名）*雨天条件
斯特罗尔 - 赛点车队 - 2020年土耳其大奖赛（第4名）*异常抓地力条件
菲利普·马萨 - 威廉姆斯车队 - 2014年奥地利大奖赛（第3名）
帕斯托·马尔多纳多 - 威廉姆斯车队 - 2012年西班牙大奖赛（第8名）
尼科·霍肯伯格 - 威廉姆斯车队 - 2010年巴西大奖赛（第6名）*湿地条件
吉安卡洛·费斯切拉 - 印度力量车队 - 2009年比利时大奖赛（第9名）
阿隆索 - 雷诺 - 2009年匈牙利大奖赛（第8名）
亚诺·特鲁利 - 丰田 - 2009年巴林大奖赛（第5名）
塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔 - 红牛二队 - 2008年意大利大奖赛（第6名）*雨天比赛
罗伯特·库比卡 - 宝马索伯 - 2008年巴林大奖赛（第3名）
虽然阿尔派凭借在获取所需尾流方面的完美执行度过了美好的一天，但常务董事史蒂夫·尼尔森表示，车队在正赛中的表现——加斯利最终名列第七、弗兰科·科拉平托名列第九——才是其真实速度更为实际的体现。
他坦言，排位赛之前的模拟数据显示，现实一点来说，能争取到的也就是Q3的末尾位置，而车队随后却上演了惊喜。
“我们当时刚好压在Q3淘汰线之上，”他对The 比赛说道，“我认为在排位赛中我们有点被高估了，因为我们没有犯任何错误。”
“我们获得了很好的尾流，车手们没有犯任何错误，也没有过度压榨赛车，我们跑出了最好的单圈。”
“我们把这辆车的性能发挥到了极致。老实说，其他车队没有做到，而这就足以让我们拿到杆位。”
不可避免地，阿尔派 让自己抱有了希望：既然在 F1 中赛道上的位置如此重要，从前排发车或许能让它在周日有机会创造一些了不起的成绩。
但正如尼尔森所说，在 F1 中，当要把一个不错的杆位转化为比赛成绩时，现实只会“迎面给你一记重拳”。
“在正赛中，这就是我们的真实速度，”他说。“我们重新回到了中游集团的顶端，这很美好。但我们仍然够不着前四名，而那才是我们想要达到的位置。”
阿尔派（阿尔派）“被当头一棒”——在方格旗挥下时重新跌回中游、落后于前四名——这一幕凸显出车队明显分成了两个阵营。
围场里的许多人认为，这种差距——以及它在一次重大规则改革后依然延续的事实——是预算帽带来的结果。
自2021年实施以来，预算帽对改善一级方程式的整体健康状况起到了关键作用，车队从为了生存而无限挣扎变成了盈利中心，但令人意外的一点是，它并没有让竞争变得那么均等。
没错，大车队已经无法再砸更多的钱去争夺胜利、进一步拉大优势。但这并不意味着小车队就有了迎头赶上的自由。
威廉姆斯车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯坚信，历史基础设施方面的优势已经被锁定——因为花费自由度不足以让落后者追上来。
“这是我们在这项运动中做出的最佳规则决定，真的是这样，”他最近在接受The 比赛采访时这样评价预算上限。
“但它同时也把任何人因此获得的优势或差距给锁定了。”
“所以现在有前四名和其他车队这样的格局，我并不感到意外。我们就直说吧。”
“这其实更多是多年前所奠定的基础。哪怕只是最基本的东西，比如你如何搭建组织架构、背后的学习方法、如何进行外部生产、与哪些供应商合作。
“这是十年来在正确水平上持续投入积累起来的成果。而不是花一两年时间试图追赶回来。
“成本上限做得非常好的地方在于，它让我们成了一门正经的生意。但不幸的是，它也意味着我不得不把大量资金投入到修补这些基础问题上，而其他车队则不需要这样做。”
尼尔森认为，阿尔派 走向成功不能只靠设计出更好的赛车。同样重要的是提升工厂的效率——也就是说，让花出去的每一美元都能获得更大的回报。
detailEn: Pierre Gasly’s pole position at the Italian Grand Prix was one of the biggest shocks that Formula 1 has seen in a while.
In fact, over the past decade there have been just two pole positions by drivers outside the current big four teams of Mercedes, McLaren, Ferrari and Red Bull.

That was Kevin Magnussen’s sprint pole for Haas from the 2022 Brazilian GP and Lance Stroll’s top spot for Racing Point in 2020 Turkish GP qualifying. Both of those, however, were assisted by outside influences throwing in an extra level of unpredictability.

In Magnussen’s case, it was the weather as a downpour at the end of the session meant his early SQ3 effort could not be toppled. For Stroll, Istanbul’s super slippery track surface threw up a bit of a curveball that Racing Point mastered.
Gasly’s moment in the spotlight at Monza was a bit different because it was secured on merit in completely normal dry conditions.

The performance spread between everyone was small and key to nailing a qualifying lap was execution and track positioning – something that Alpine did to perfection as the big squads all got it wrong for different reasons.

Such toppling of the F1 frontrunners on normal weekends does happen, like Felipe Massa’s 2014 Austrian GP pole or Pastor Maldonado’s from his amazing 2012 Spanish GP weekend, both of those achieved by Williams, but is incredibly rare.
If we pore through the history books, such unusual outcomes have pretty much dried up – as can be seen from the below table of pole positions by the non-big four squads.
Most recent poles by squads outside of 'big four' + team's position in constructors' championship
Pierre Gasly - Alpine - 2026 Italian GP (currently 6th)
Kevin Magnussen - Haas - 2022 Brazilin GP (8th) *wet weather
Lance Stroll - Racing Point - 2020 Turkish GP (4th) *abnormal grip
Felipe Massa - Williams - 2014 Austrian GP (3rd)
Pastor Maldonado - Williams - 2012 Spanish GP (8th)
Nico Hulkenberg - Williams - 2010 Brazilian GP (6th) *wet weather
Giancarlo Fisichella - Force India - 2009 Belgian GP (9th)
Fernando Alonso - Renault - 2009 Hungarian GP (8th)
Jarno Trulli - Toyota - 2009 Bahrain GP (5th)
Sebastian Vettel - Toro Rosso - 2008 Italian GP (6th) *wet weather
Robert Kubica - BMW Sauber - 2008 Bahrain GP (3rd)

While Alpine had its day in the sun thanks to perfect execution in getting the tow it needed, managing director Steve Nielsen says the team’s performance in the race – where Gasly came home seventh and Franco Colapinto ninth – was a more realistic reflection of what its true pace was.
He confessed that the simulations heading into qualifying had suggested the bottom end of Q3 was all that was realistically on the table before it pulled off its surprise.
“We were just over the cut-off for Q3,” he told The Race. “I think we were a bit flattered [in qualifying] that we didn't make any mistakes.
“We got good tows, the drivers didn't make any mistakes, they didn't overdrive, and we put our best lap together.
“We got the best out of the car. And honestly, others didn't, and that was good enough to put us on pole.”
Alpine, inevitably, allowed itself to hope that, with track position so important in F1, starting at the front could give it a sniff of something awesome on Sunday.
But in F1, as Nielsen says, reality only ever “punches you straight in the face” when it comes to turning a good pole into a race result.
“In the race, that is our pace,” he said. “We were back to being top of the midfield, which is lovely. But we're still out of reach of the top four, which is where we want to be.”
What the “punch in the face” of Alpine reverting to the mean in slipping behind the top four by the chequered flag highlights is that there is a clear divide of teams into two categories.
Many in the paddock believe that the divide - and the fact it has been carried through a major rule overhaul - is a consequence of the cost cap.

While the cost cap has been critical in improving F1’s overall health since it was introduced in 2021, with teams becoming profit centres rather than facing an endless fight for survival, one surprise element is how it has not equalised things all that much.
Yes, the big teams have been unable to throw even more money at winning to make the victory margins bigger. But that has not meant the smaller squads having the freedom to catch up.
Williams boss James Vowles is adamant that legacy infrastructure advantages have been locked in – because there is not the spending freedom to allow those behind to catch up.
“Best rule decision we made in the sport, it really is,” he told The Race recently about the cost cap.
“But what it did is also lock in any advantage or differential that was created by anyone else as a result of it.
“It's not a surprise to me that you have the top four and the rest, which is what you have today. Let's be blunt about it.

“That is actually more to do with what was created many years ago. Even just basics on how you do your structures, your learning behind it, how you do your outside production, the suppliers you work with.
“That's built up over 10 years of investing at the right level. Not one or two years of trying to catch back up.

“What cost cap does really well is it means we're a business. But what it does also, unfortunately, is it means that I'm putting a lot of dollars into just trying to fix basics, which others won't be.”
Nielsen sees Alpine’s route to success being not about just designing a better car. It is as much about improving efficiency at the factory – so getting a bigger bang for each buck spent.

detailZh: 法拉利的ADUO 2升级对哈斯来说也不是“游戏规则改变者”
奥利弗·比尔曼坚称法拉利更新的动力单元并没有带来显著的性能提升
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利；奥利弗·比尔曼，哈斯F1车队
奥利弗·比尔曼表示，法拉利的ADUO 2引擎升级相比哈斯更新的F1底盘只是“小得多的进步”。
跃马借助额外发展与升级机会（ADUO）系统，推出了2026赛季第二次也是最后一次动力单元升级，其中一套动力总成交给了哈斯车队，用于意大利大奖赛，并被安装到了贝尔曼的赛车上。
这支美国车队取得了些许进展，这位年轻的英国车手排位赛名列第12，这是他自3月中国大奖赛以来的最好成绩。然而，哈斯在蒙扎仍然遭遇了连续第七站颗粒无收，追平了自2021年那个糟糕赛季以来最长的连续不胜纪录。
贝尔曼在开场几圈曾短暂占据第八位，但随后由于跟不上阿尔派和小红牛的节奏而在名次上不断下滑。由于他没有在虚拟安全车期间进站，最终在格子旗挥动时仅以第15名完赛。
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔此前已明确表示，ADUO 2动力总成不会成为改变局面的法宝，贝尔曼在排位赛后也对此表示认同。
“这比之前的（空气动力学）升级包的进步幅度要小得多，可以这么说，”这位21岁的车手评论道。“当然，在这条赛道上会多带来一些优势，但就整个赛季的平均水平而言，说实话，如果我们在赞德沃特就用上这台引擎，也不足以让我们摆脱晋级第一阶段（Q1）的争夺。我不认为它是一个改变局面的东西。
“当然，更多动力总是好事，但你已经看到了关于它带来多少提升的报道。它肯定有益处，但最大的进步是那个（空气动力学）升级包，它带来的收益是引擎动力提升的两到三倍——这证明了车队努力工作的成果，我真的、真的为他们感到骄傲。”
哈斯车队为蒙扎准备的升级包括经过重新设计的底板，以及侧箱和引擎盖部分修改过的车体部件。虽然没能用上新的动力单元，但奥孔确实受益于新的空气动力学部件，不过在第二阶段（Q2）中他仍然比队友慢了十分之七秒。
然而，这并不意味着法拉利的新引擎价值十分之七秒，因为这位法国车手受到了VF-26空气动力学表现不稳定问题的困扰——他认为本赛季至今13场大奖赛中有10场都被这个问题所困扰。
当被问及排位赛之后赛车的不稳定性是否比练习赛有所改善时，奥孔回答道：“没有，很遗憾没有好转。我们竭尽全力，把车库里的所有部件都装到了车上。我们已经做了能做的一切，但还是没有找到问题的根源。
“很遗憾，和奥利相比，我们的下压力损失仍然很大，尤其是赛车尾部。这显然不理想，但技师们为此付出的努力非常了不起。
“而且我对自己的飞驰圈是满意的，你知道，毕竟我觉得自己跑出了很强的一圈，我对此感到高兴。但下压力的差距加上引擎的损失，在这里损失是相当大的。所以这已经是我们能做到的极限了。”
至少这位老将可以从空气动力学升级件在另一辆赛车上的效果中得到一些安慰：“那些升级件在奥利那边确实起作用了，是的，有效的。”不过两辆车仍然都排在奥迪之后，而这家德国制造商在车队总冠军积分榜上只落后五分。
尼克·霍肯伯格，奥迪一级方程式车队，奥利弗·比尔曼，哈斯一级方程式车队
detailEn: Ferrari’s ADUO 2 upgrade is no “game changer” for Haas either
Oliver Bearman insists Ferrari’s updated power unit didn’t provide a significant performance gain
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Oliver Bearman, Haas F1 Team
Oliver Bearman says Ferrari’s ADUO 2 engine upgrade represents “a much smaller step” than Haas’ updated Formula 1 chassis.

The Prancing Horse introduced its second and final power unit upgrade of the 2026 season, courtesy of the Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities system, with one such powertrain handed to Haas for the Italian Grand Prix. It was fitted to Bearman’s car.

There was slight progress for the American team, as the young Briton qualified 12th, his best result since the Chinese Grand Prix in March. However, Haas still endured a seventh consecutive point-less round at Monza, equalling its worst streak since its 2021 write-off.

Bearman briefly held eighth place in the opening laps, but subsequently slipped back down the order as he couldn’t keep up with the Alpines and Racing Bulls. Having not pitted under the virtual safety car, he ended up down in 15th under the chequered flag.
Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur had made it clear that the ADUO 2 powertrain was not going to be a game changer, and Bearman agreed after qualifying.

“It's a much smaller step than what the [aero] upgrade was, let's say,” the 21-year-old commented. “Of course, there's a bit more in this track, but in terms of a season average, it wouldn't have been enough to get us out of the fight for Q1, to be honest, if you put that engine on us in Zandvoort. I don't think it was a game changer.

“Of course, more power is always nice, but you've read the news about how much it is. It's definitely beneficial, but the biggest step was the [aero] upgrade, which was more than twice or three times the amount of power we got from the engine – which is testament to the team's hard work, and I'm really, really proud of them for that.”

The Haas upgrade for Monza featured, among others, a revamped floor and revised bodywork on the sidepods and engine cover. While missing out on the new power unit, Ocon did benefit from the new aerodynamic parts, but still ended up seven tenths slower than his team-mate in Q2.

However, that does not mean Ferrari’s new engine is worth seven tenths, as the Frenchman suffered from the VF-26’s aero inconsistency – an issue that he believes to have plagued him at 10 of 13 grands prix so far this year.

Asked after qualifying if the car’s inconsistency was any better than in practice, Ocon replied: “No, it wasn't, unfortunately. We tried everything we could, taking all the bits in the garage to put it on the car. We did everything that we could, but we didn't get to the bottom of the issue.
“Unfortunately, we're still losing a lot of load compared to Ollie, especially on the rear of the car. It's not ideal, clearly, but the guys did a mega job by trying that.

“And I was happy with my lap, you know. At the end of the day, I feel like I did a strong lap, I was happy with it. But the deficit of downforce plus the engine losses, it's quite a lot around here. So that's the max that we could have done.”

At least the veteran could find solace in the aero upgrades’ efficiency on the sister car: “They worked on Ollie’s side, yes, they did.” But both cars still finished behind the Audis, with the German brand just five points in arrears in the constructors’ championship.
Nico Hulkenberg, Audi F1 Team, Oliver Bearman, Haas F1 Team

items.originalTitle: 蒙托亚：梅赛德斯本应在蒙扎让拉塞尔和安东内利双车进站
items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya believes Mercedes compromised George Russell's Italian Grand Prix by not double-stacking its drivers under the virtual safety car. Mercedes still finished 1-2 at Monza, with Kimi Antonelli recovering from 19th on the grid to win.
detailZh: Juan Pablo Montoya：梅赛德斯应该在蒙扎让拉塞尔和安东内利双进站
Juan Pablo Montoya认为，梅赛德斯没有在虚拟安全车期间让两位车手双进站，损害了拉塞尔的意大利大奖赛
前F1车手Juan Pablo Montoya认为，梅赛德斯没有在虚拟安全车期间让两位车手双进站，从而损害了拉塞尔的意大利大奖赛。
梅赛德斯在蒙扎取得了1-2名完赛，由本土英雄安东内利领衔，他从第19位发车逆袭，成为自1966年以来首位在该赛道夺冠的意大利车手。但Russell控制了比赛的前半段，原本是夺冠的最大热门，直到比赛中期的一次虚拟安全车改变了他的比赛。
当时正处于领先位置的这位英国车手被留在了赛道上，而安东内利则进站换胎。这位意大利车手随后在车阵中一路追赶，并超越拉塞尔夺得了冠军。
蒙托亚在F1 TV的赛后节目中表示，梅赛德斯本应优先让拉塞尔进站。
“他当时在领跑，理应获得优先进站的待遇。当虚拟安全车出现时，在那一刻，进站比留在赛道上更快。他们应该让他进站，应该让他双堆叠进站，这样他就会停在安东内利前面，”这位哥伦比亚车手解释道。
安东内利，梅赛德斯，拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
“我并不是说Antonelli不会依然追上他并赢得比赛，但那本来会是一场像我们之前看到的那样非常接近的较量。对所有人来说，比赛结束阶段本来会非常精彩。”
车队领队Toto Wolff回应了有关这支Brackley车队策略偏袒Antonelli的说法。“两停本是最佳方案，但我们当时并不这么认为，所以这实际上对他有利，”他在赛后告诉天空体育 F1。
“但今天没有任何东西能阻止他（Antonelli）。George最后是靠着磨损的轮胎在战斗，所以对一二名完赛我感到非常高兴。”
当被问及Russell是否还有其他选择时，Wolff补充道：“没有，George用的是硬胎，我们必须按一停来跑，所以根本没有机会。”
detailEn: Juan Pablo Montoya: Mercedes should have double-stacked George Russell and Kimi Antonelli at Monza
Juan Pablo Montoya believes Mercedes compromised George Russell’s Italian Grand Prix by not double-stacking its drivers under the virtual safety car
Former Formula 1 driver Juan Pablo Montoya believes Mercedes compromised George Russell's Italian Grand Prix by not double-stacking its drivers under the virtual safety car.

Mercedes secured a 1-2 finish at Monza led by home hero Kimi Antonelli, who recovered from 19th on the grid to become the first Italian winner at the circuit since 1966. But Russell controlled the early phases of the race and was positioned as the primary candidate for victory before a mid-race virtual safety car period altered his race.
The Briton, who was leading at the time, was left out on track while Antonelli pitted. The Italian went on to make his way back through the pack and overtook Russell for the win.
Speaking on F1 TV's post-race show, Montoya argued Mercedes should have given Russell the priority pitstop.

"He was leading and he should have had the priority on the pitstop. When that virtual safety car came, at that point, it's quicker to stop than staying out. They should have stopped him, they should have double-stacked him, and he should have stopped ahead of Antonelli," the Colombian explained.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes

"And I'm not saying Antonelli wouldn't still catch him and win the race, but it would have been a really close fight like we saw earlier on. It would have been a really cool race at the end for all of us."

Team chief Toto Wolff addressed claims the Brackley outfit's strategy favoured Antonelli. "The two-stop was the best but we didn't think it was the case, so that was good for him actually," he told Sky Sports F1 after the race.
"But today there was nothing that would have stopped him [Antonelli]. George fought with worn-out tools at the end, so I'm really happy for the one-two."
When asked if there were any other options for Russell, Wolff added: "No, George was on the hard and we needed to go on the one-stop so there was no chance."
